locators.Nested cross-validation procedure: Five outer Ephys folds; fifty outer WFI folds; ten random repeats; median decoding R-squared across repeats. Averaged decoded priors are a distinct output.
locators.Assessing statistical significance: 1000 pseudosessions; session corrected R-squared subtracts median pseudoscore; regional corrected R-squared is the mean of session corrections.
locators.Inclusion criteria for the analysis: At least 250 included trials and five units/pixels; 414 Ephys and 51 WFI region-level sessions; separate 171-session / 806-region-session Ephys embodiment subset; no WFI video recordings.
locators.Embodiment analysis / DLC prior decoding: Seven behavioral variables, L1 regression with the neural cross-validation scheme, same retained Ephys trials; session-level movement decoding compared with region-session neural decoding.
